data.name: Devamala
data.gender_notes: Devamala is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Devamala is a name of Sanskrit origin, derived from the words 'Deva' meaning 'God' and 'Mala' meaning 'Garland'. It is believed to represent the one who is adorned with the garlands of God's blessings and grace. The name Devamala carries the meaning “God's Garland” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Devamala usually hope their child will grow to embody god's garland and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who is adorned with the blessings of the Gods.
data.etymology: Devamala belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Garland.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Devamala total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Devamala has roots in the rich cultural heritage of Hinduism. It showcases the deep reverence and faith Hindus have for their deities, as a garland is a symbolic offering of love and respect. The name also reflects the belief in the divine presence in everything and everyone.
data.spiritual_significance: Devamala signifies being blessed and graced by the divine. It represents a devotee who is spiritually uplifted and adorned with the garlands of God's love and compassion. It is a constant reminder of the divine connection and the spiritual growth that comes from staying close to the deities.
